value.rationale: This is a complete field-dependent energy-barrier atlas for a canonical finite frustrated magnetic cluster. It distinguishes non-ground absorbing configurations from equilibrium states, identifies 44 distinct excited traps in two magnetic regimes and two exact nonmonotone barrier peaks while the equilibrium ground-state phase remains fixed, and gives uniform shortest escape paths and orbit structure. These mathematically sharp minimax energies are meaningful benchmarks for low-temperature kinetics; no unproved lifetime asymptotic is claimed.
